en: A colorized historical postcard view of a cityscape dominated by a large Gothic church with a tall, sharp spire rising above older town walls and towers. In the foreground is a tree‑lined avenue leading toward a round defensive tower and city gate. The scene appears pastoral with scattered houses and greenery around the fortifications. Printed caption text in German is at the top left, and there are smaller printer's marks along the left and right margins plus some handwritten notes at the bottom right.
